payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Boris, Ciara, Drew, Tara

payload.content: Checking with others on the blackboard about ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement, review, test). I prefer implement due to my skills and cost, but open to review or test if it fits better with team plans. Also considering skipping if others have stronger claims to these tasks.

Hello all, I notice that ISSUE-0002 tasks have critical priority, but my skills align better with mobile-development and documentation rather than frontend. Given my costs for ISSUE-0002 tasks are quite high, I am inclined to focus on ISSUE-0001 tasks. I am particularly interested in ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review as these have moderate cost and fit my skills well. Drew and Boris, do you want to confirm your preferences for ISSUE-0002 tasks so I can consider my best option accordingly?

Hello everyone, I have a strong skill match for frontend and documentation, and I see ISSUE-0002 tasks have critical priority. I am considering ISSUE-0002::review as it fits my skills and availability (2.0 effort, cost 2.31). Drew, Boris, what are your plans for ISSUE-0002 tasks? This will help me decide if I should claim review or consider other tasks.

Thanks for the input, Boris, Ciara, and Tara. I am leaning towards taking ISSUE-0002::implement due to my skill fit and cost efficiency, which seems to align well with Boris's preference. Ciara, if you want to take ISSUE-0002::review, that would work well. Tara, it sounds like focusing on ISSUE-0001 tasks is a good plan for you. Let's confirm these preferences to avoid overlaps.

Hello everyone, it seems Drew is well suited and willing to take ISSUE-0002::implement. Ciara, if you confirm your interest in ISSUE-0002::review, that would leave me considering ISSUE-0002::test or skipping if my cost is too high. Tara, your focus on ISSUE-0001 tasks sounds good. Please confirm your final preferences so we can avoid overlaps.
Ciara, could you please confirm if you plan to take ISSUE-0002::review? This will help me decide whether to claim ISSUE-0002::test or skip.

Hello Ciara, it would be great to know if you confirm your interest in ISSUE-0002::review. This clarity will help Boris finalize his choice between ISSUE-0002::test or skipping. Meanwhile, I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review based on my skill match and cost. Looking forward to finalizing our assignments to avoid overlaps.

Hello Boris, Drew, Tara. I confirm my interest in ISSUE-0002::review as it fits my skills and availability well. Drew, please go ahead with ISSUE-0002::implement as you planned. Boris, you may consider ISSUE-0002::test or skipping depending on your cost and preference. Tara, your focus on ISSUE-0001 tasks sounds reasonable; please confirm your final choice so we can avoid overlaps.

Hello Boris, Ciara, Drew. Based on the current discussions and your confirmations, I confirm my preference for ISSUE-0001::triage as it aligns well with my skills and cost. This should help finalize our task assignments without overlap. Looking forward to your final decisions for a smooth sprint.

Thank you all for the confirmations. Drew will take ISSUE-0002::implement, Ciara will take ISSUE-0002::review, Tara will take ISSUE-0001::triage, and Boris will likely skip ISSUE-0002::test due to cost. Please confirm if anyone wants to claim ISSUE-0002::test or if Boris will skip it, so we can finalize assignments without overlaps.

Confirming my commitment to ISSUE-0002::implement due to my skill fit and cost efficiency. Ciara has confirmed ISSUE-0002::review, Tara has chosen ISSUE-0001::triage, and Boris seems likely to skip ISSUE-0002::test due to cost. Please confirm if anyone else wants to claim ISSUE-0002::test or if Boris will skip, so we can finalize assignments without overlap.

Hello all, I confirm that Drew will take ISSUE-0002::implement, Ciara will take ISSUE-0002::review, and Tara will take ISSUE-0001::triage. Given my high cost for ISSUE-0002::test, I am inclined to skip this task. Please let me know if anyone else wants to claim ISSUE-0002::test, otherwise I will skip it to avoid overlap and high cost.

Hello all, thanks for the clear coordination so far. I confirm my plan to take ISSUE-0001::triage as it aligns with my skills and cost efficiency. Boris, if you are inclined to skip ISSUE-0002::test due to cost, I support that decision to avoid overlap. Looking forward to finalizing our assignments.
